nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Environment variable template for the Vite frontend, declaring the single VITE_API_BASE_URL setting used to point the app at the backend API.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite HTML entry point for the React application; mounts the app into a root div and loads the Montserrat/Rye Google Fonts before bootstrapping main.tsx as a module script.

nodes.name: login.html
nodes.summary: Standalone static login page with its own inline CSS color tokens and layout, unrelated to the Vite/React entry point and not wired into the main application bundle or routing; likely a legacy or mockup page kept outside the React app.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines its own :root CSS variables (--cream, --ink, --clay, --amber, etc.) that duplicate concepts from the project's Design System rather than consuming shared tokens.css, and loads a different font pairing (Rye + Nunito Sans) than index.html (Montserrat + Rye). This file is not referenced from index.html and has no script src pointing at the app bundle, supporting the assessment that it is a disconnected legacy page not wired into the React app.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: NPM manifest for the Rolliúde Play frontend, declaring the Vite/React build scripts, runtime dependencies, dev dependencies, and the packageManager/engines constraints for the project.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the frontend, defining compilerOptions and the include pattern that scopes type-checking to the project's source files.
